plan.data: Sheetpedia workbooks from the part of the release archive after the first 540 MB (disjoint from the development and held-out sets, which came from the first 500 MB), shuffled with seed 2025, first 300 loadable workbooks with formulas, up to 25 formulas each
plan.primary: share of formulas rejected by the shipped verifier (v1) and by GroundCheck (v2), with a workbook-clustered bootstrap interval
plan.secondary: rejection categories, agreement of rejections with the independent engine, flag rate
plan.rule: scored once with the frozen verifier; no verifier change is made after seeing these results, and any defect found is reported as a limitation
